title: FRA F 30
description: The Federal Railroad Administration's certifications regarding debarment and suspension, a drug-free workplace and lobbying. The applicant lists up to three places of performance, checks two boxes, and gives the certifying official's name and title; Grants.gov fills in the signature and date.
notes: Parts A, B and C, the certifying statement and the burden statement are quoted exactly from the DAT as section descriptions.

The XSD numbers three place-of-performance elements (`PlaceofPerformance1` to `3`). The form asks for a list of up to three, and the XML mapping writes each item to its numbered element with `Mapping.Item` (`places_of_performance[0]` to `[2]`).
The list of places renders with the frontend's FieldListControl, one text input per place.
The two checkboxes use the shared Yes/No question, a boolean the XML mapping writes as `Y: Yes` or `N: No`.
Part A asks a grantee that can't certify to attach an explanation. The form has no attachment field for it, like the paper form.

Signature and Submitted Date are filled in by the API on submission (`gg_post_population` rules `signature` and `current_date`), so the form shows them read-only. The XSD wraps the signature and the name and title in `AuthorizedRepresentative`, which only the `xml-mapping` format can write.
Labels are the DAT's, in title case. Standardizing them on the question bank's labels comes later.
